title: Syrian Fish Hash
description: A flavorful Syrian-inspired breakfast dish made with crispy fish and warm hash.

ingredients.name: Fish Fillets
ingredients.notes: Fresh fish, preferably cod or tilapia

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the fish fillets and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until cooked through.
Meanwhile, cook the hash browns in a separate pan until golden brown, about 5 minutes per side.
Season the fish and hash with salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Serve the fish on top of the hash browns and garnish with chopped parsley.
